caseName: Broadcast Music, Inc. v. Columbia Broadcasting System, Inc.
caseNameFull: Broadcast Music, Inc. v. Columbia Broadcasting System, Inc. and American Society of Composers, Authors, & Publishers v. Columbia Broadcasting System, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 817.] Motions of National Broadcasting Co., Inc., American Broadcasting Companies, Inc., and National Religious Broadcasters, Inc., for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted. Motion of All-Industry Television Music License Committee for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae denied.
